svg.title: Origins using each CMS, mobile (headless)
svg.desc: Number of origins in the HTTP Archive crawl detected as using Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, Payload on mobile, monthly from 2020-01 to 2026-09. Origins are websites visited in the Chrome UX Report, not live sites, and a CMS missing from the chart has no HTTP Archive series (n/a). The desktop crawl shows the same trends.

text.tspan: Source: HTTP Archive Tech Report (cdn.httparchive.org/v1/adoption); retrieved 2026-10-29. Counts origins in the crawl, not sites. Raw data:
scripts/cms-comparison-charts/data/popularity.csv. See the Bibliography for the sources.
